name: agent-modular-synth
description: ブラウザとローカル環境で動作し、人間とエージェントが操作できるモジュラーシンセ(実装中: エンジン核)

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run typecheck && node --test dist/test/*.test.js && node dist/test/tv-coverage.js
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && node test/browser/smoke.cjs && node test/browser/ui.cjs && node test/browser/mcp-e2e.cjs && node test/browser/review24.cjs && node test/browser/midi.cjs && node test/browser/score.cjs && node test/browser/rack.cjs && node test/browser/perf-reconnect.cjs && node test/browser/local-llm.cjs && node test/browser/panel.cjs
scripts.bench: npm run build && mkdir -p bench/results && node dist/src/perf/offline.js --json bench/results/offline.json
scripts.bench:render: npm run build && mkdir -p bench/results && node demo/make-performance.mjs demo/techno.mjs bench/results/techno.performance.json && node test/browser/bench-render.cjs bench/results/techno.performance.json --json bench/results/render.json
scripts.check: npm test && python3 tools/build_module_meta.py --check && python3 tools/validate_specs.py && python3 tools/validate_product_spec.py
